scope: README/documentation only; no CSV rows analyzed and no biological response rescored

publisher_readme_findings.initial_easting_northing: UTM geographic coordinates at initial encounter before human translocation
publisher_readme_findings.released_easting_northing: UTM geographic coordinates at experimentally released location after translocation
publisher_readme_findings.final_easting_northing: UTM geographic coordinates at final encounter after translocation/homing
publisher_readme_findings.translocated_distance: Derived from initial and release UTM positions, rounded into four listed nominal classes (0m, 100m, 250m, 500m); this is a separate variable from post-release movement distance
publisher_readme_findings.distance_release_final_or_capture_final: Readme groups the two reported distance columns under one description: distances in meters calculated from appropriate UTM coordinates; does not provide a distinct algebraic formula, control-specific replacement rule or alternative coordinate reference
publisher_readme_findings.reencounter_timing: Usually the day after first capture
publisher_readme_findings.angle_units_in_readme: angles stated in degrees; not used for current geographic source audit

original_article_context.method: Original Herpetologica methods describes initial, post-translocation release and next-night final UTM positions, and Euclidean release-to-final distance in meters
original_article_context.context_source: Publicly indexed full-text article extraction and original Dryad landing summary, not the README itself
original_article_context.interpretation: Article method and authenticated README are consistent on expected source coordinate roles. Neither documents a rule explaining the earlier numerical discordance.

next_data_quality_question: Check whether mismatch is restricted to translocated versus zero-distance controls using a predeclared post-STOP QA stratum, without changing original H1 or treating any alternate reconstruction as validated
